assets.title: Two-Tier Inclined-Peg Spool Rack
assets.description: One original low-poly free-standing spool rack, counted together as one complete prop. Two ground feet and uprights support two separate crossrails. Each crossrail carries three forward-and-upward inclined pegs and independent annular end-shoulder seats. Three true through-bore spools sit on their shoulders and three positions remain empty. Each spool has thick shaped end flanges, a genuinely hollow core and an attached coloured thread wrap. The entire nonbearing peg/bore interface remains positively separated. Twenty-four editable closed meshes and five opaque constant PBR materials; metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. No tray, fabric, loose thread, sewing machine, labels, textures, scene or animation. Static storage-display pose only: no unwinding, weaving, sewing, rotation, insertion/removal path, thread tension, friction, material behaviour, manufacture, load, stability or safety claim. No compatibility with historical spools, machines or scenes is asserted.
